propositions: Reconciliation passes with silently-failed sub-operations (swallowed comment errors) report success (exit 0) instead of failure, making sync failures invisible.
The comment_errors collection in apply_handlers.py records partial failures non-fatally and does not increment mutation_failures, so reconciliation exit code remains 0 despite failures.
Partial comment drops must be promoted to fatal errors (outcome[error]) only when RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP flag is enabled, keeping default behavior unchanged for backward compatibility.
Silent no-op canary coverage must extend beyond links to include comments and labels to detect all types of partial failures.
The fail-loud flag activation must be sequenced after Jira comment cleanup to avoid false failures on capped tickets with legitimate unsynced comments.
